It calls the shared support helpers and core's set_value_in_buffer. The only lint flag is an `unreachable!` after validation, which is truly unreachable: ValidateIntegerTypedArray throws for non-objects. The test262 target went from 8 to 32 passing with no regressions, which fits a stub that was filled in. I could only see the diff, so I did not check the support helpers' internals.
